subject: reasoning
question: If SINGLE is coded as 383287242 and PYRAMID is coded as 32503612634, then how will RADIOUS be coded?
solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1196a07d03c9f02e7bec22cfc36a195fd3a58e076da25a1e2a394b79aea80ec7.png] 

The logic follows here is:

The vowel is coded as;

A = 1, E = 2, I = 3. O = 4, U = 5

Single-digit positional value letter as it is.

The double-digit positional value letter is doubled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f21a244ad085e384432a881dcf422d252bae0c82eafd06ef6e3f46981faf1aae.png] 

And;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31193eceb7ea3efe86fab6ea296813aebceacba6b69b46013f477affa68177a9.png] 

Similarly;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51710d3b6a08a73239ee9923d6d3e15de5bc1e6d2cfea8feeb2f2c125ac83d5a.png] 

Hence, **"361434538"** is the correct answer.
